determination: No mapped physical OSM land visible at z13 and no OSM coastline or island polygon intersects this tile. The remaining 31,232 native NoData pixel centers are NOT demonstrated to be required on Colombian OSM land, so this does not block the source selection.
proof_limit: OSM Standard rendered imagery is not a raw 256x256 geometry-accurate coastline polygon mask.
